messages.subject: Registration for introductory workshop closes in 8 days (21Jun23)
parts:
Thanks to those who have already registered for the workshop taking place 10-21 July 2023. There are places still available, but registration closes 21 June 2023.

You will learn the fundamentals of distance sampling as well as the analysis of distance sampling data. Equally important you will get to interact with other researchers and students interested in distance sampling questions. Not only will you learn how to produce estimates of animal abundance using distance sampling, but also detect signals indicating that inference produced from a survey (and its analysis) might be unsound. This skill is important not only for those conducting distance sampling surveys, but also for researchers/managers/decision makers who consume findings of distance sampling surveys.

You will learn not only how to produce detection function figures such as this
but more importantly, how to interpret such figures and understand what they tell us about the biology of the animals we are studying.

Complete registration details can be found at the link below. In addition, I'm happy to answer questions you might have.

https://workshops.distancesampling.org/intro-jul-2023

Eric Rexstad

Centre for Research into Ecological and Environmental Modelling
